name: Oviya, Automech Artisan — "each creature that's attacking one of your opponents" is the attackers, not what opponents control
notes: Found by the subject probe (2026-10-12). The word 'opponents' made the filter 'permanents your opponents control', so every opposing permanent, lands included, gained trample. It is now any player's attacking creature whose attacked player (the pick on the card, else the first other player) is not Oviya's controller.

scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Goblin Piker
